verdict.rationale: Pika's own docs say it scores any clip to picture with music, ambience and foley matched to the action. It also offers text-to-SFX (Pika SFX) and music generation (MiniMax Music 3.0), all within one product that brings video, image, and sound creation into one place. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scene-matching works, in-depth documentation beyond one-line feature claims.
